name: rocket-league
description: Rocket League - car football for Bloxity (Three.js + Colyseus, server-authoritative physics)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @rlb/server && npm run build --workspace @rlb/client
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @rlb/client
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @rlb/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run test:physics && npm run build:server && node scripts/sim-match.mjs 3
